purpose: Primary-source reading log for introductory Vietnamese learning materials about incident type 2 diabetes prognosis and survival analysis.
scope_status: Educational notes only; not a finalized protocol, dataset selection, model selection, or frozen prediction horizon.
example_provenance: All four-person tables and numerical teaching examples in the learning materials are explicitly fictional, authored for teaching, and are not empirical evidence or model results.

sources.title: Introduction to Survival Analysis with scikit-survival
sources.what_was_read: Right-censored observations retain information up to last follow-up; the survival target combines an observed duration with an event indicator.
sources.limits: Methods teaching only; no example disease, sample size, or performance result is transferred to the proposed T2D research.

sources.title: Understanding Predictions in Survival Analysis
sources.what_was_read: Definitions of survival, hazard, cumulative hazard, and the role of covariates in Cox predictions. Hazard is treated as an instantaneous rate, not an absolute probability.
sources.limits: The complement of a single-event survival estimate is not automatically an event-specific cumulative incidence in the presence of competing risks.

sources.title: Evaluating Survival Models
sources.what_was_read: C-index, censoring-related limitations, cumulative/dynamic AUC, and time-dependent/integrated Brier scores; discrimination does not establish calibration.
sources.limits: No metric result or preferred estimator for a specific unselected dataset is asserted.

sources.title: Analysis of Competing Risks
read_locations: Non-parametric Estimator of the Cumulative Incidence Function
sources.what_was_read: A competing event can prevent an event of interest; ordinary censoring of competing events followed by one minus Kaplan-Meier does not yield the real-world event-specific cumulative incidence.
sources.limits: A teaching caveat, not a mandatory finalized competing-risk analysis plan for the proposed research.

sources.title: Survival regression
read_locations: Fitting the regression: formulas and interactions
sources.what_was_read: Cox baseline hazard and covariate effects; formula-based interactions and spline support; interpretation of exponentiated coefficients as hazard ratios.
sources.limits: Cox is introduced as a reference model, not selected as the final method.

sources.title: Testing the proportional hazard assumptions
sources.what_was_read: Functional-form misspecification and nonlinear predictor terms; spline example; distinction between nonlinear covariate effects and proportional hazards over time.
sources.limits: No assumption test was performed, and no conclusion about an unselected dataset is drawn.

sources.title: Estimating univariate models: Interval censored data
sources.what_was_read: Event times may be bounded between observation periods rather than exactly observed; interval-censored data require a different representation from ordinary right-censored data.
sources.limits: The teaching table explicitly distinguishes recorded detection time from an interval-bounded state transition and does not claim to observe biological onset.

sources.title: Common pitfalls and recommended practices: Data leakage
sources.what_was_read: Split before learned preprocessing; fit transformations and feature selection using training partitions only; pipelines help preserve separation in cross-validation and tuning.
sources.limits: No code, dependencies, or model pipeline were introduced. Final-test tuning restrictions also follow repository EXPERIMENT_POLICY.md.

sources.title: TRIPOD statement official website: TRIPOD+AI overview
sources.what_was_read: TRIPOD+AI provides a harmonized reporting checklist for regression and machine-learning prediction models and replaces the 2015 checklist.
sources.limits: Reporting guidance does not certify methodological validity or clinical readiness.

sources.title: TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods
read_locations: Abstract and introductory guidance as exposed in browser/search extracts
sources.what_was_read: The statement updates reporting guidance for prediction models regardless of regression or machine-learning methods; diagnostic and prognostic model purposes must be distinguished.
sources.limits: Not a completed item-by-item TRIPOD+AI audit. DOI 10.1136/bmj.q902 is a correction notice and is not substituted for the main statement.

sources.title: DeepSurv: personalized treatment recommender system using a Cox proportional hazards deep neural network
sources.what_was_read: DeepSurv uses a neural network for the covariate log-risk function within a Cox proportional-hazards formulation. Nonlinear predictor effects do not by themselves remove PH.
sources.limits: No results, treatment recommendations, empirical superiority, or T2D performance claims are adopted. This is an architecture example, not a selected study or model.
